reviewer_attestation: I attest that these are my independent human judgments.
I reviewed the AI suggestions and affirm my final human judgments.

action_labels: offline intervention evidence only; omitted from reviewer packet

completion_rules.no_observed_issue: correct semantics, valid gold, reviewed; no observed issues, cause labels or support entries; audit evidence must be available
completion_rules.issue_observed: at least one observed issue; cause hypotheses may be empty (unknown cause); one support entry per cause label
completion_rules.unresolved: deferred, no forced issue/cause; explain missing/conflicting evidence
completion_rules.independent-15: exact predetermined subset, human_only, blind self-attestation, different reviewer from primary

assistance_policy.primary-60: AI proposals seed blank rows only; no human status or attestation. Old drafts remain backups, no judgment migration across annotation revisions.
assistance_policy.independent-15: Suggestions are hidden; this scope requires a distinct human who has not seen primary suggestions.

diagnostic_support_schema.label: controlled hypothesis ID
diagnostic_support_schema.contrast_id: empty for hypothesis; registered matching hash-verified contrast for contrast_supported

blind_attestation: I have not seen AI suggestions or other reviewer judgments for this pilot.
